title: Cup of Joe’s Gian Bernardino admits past feelings for fellow OPM hitmaker Maki
summary: Cup of Joe vocalist Gian Bernardino revealed that he once had a crush on fellow OPM artist Maki, recalling that they were already friends when he developed feelings for the “Dilaw”…

blocks.text: Cup of Joe vocalist Gian Bernardino revealed that he once had a crush on fellow OPM artist Maki, recalling that they were already friends when he developed feelings for the “Dilaw” hitmaker. Bernardino made the admission during their appearance on the recent episode of “Gandang Gabi Vice” for the deep truth segment. When Vice Ganda asked when it happened, the Cup of Joe frontman replied, “Siguro mga 2025.
